subject: Hosted API pricing & capacity: monthly tokens + peak TPS (Juno Health) — recap
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@junohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-23T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing & capacity: monthly tokens + peak TPS (Juno Health) — recap

Hi Priya / Ben —

Thanks again for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and the asks I promised: we want to make sure our hosted pricing band and capacity sizing match your expected usage pattern. Please confirm or correct the numbers below.

Recap (from our conversation):
- Typical API call type: clinical note summarization + triage suggestion (avg. request = 450 tokens input, 150 tokens output).
- Estimated active users: 120k MAU (core flows); pilot subset ~10k.
- Estimated monthly tokens (ballpark): 120k users * 600 tokens avg = ~72M tokens/month.
- Alternate scenario (higher verbosity): up to ~110M tokens/month.
- Peak TPS (burst profile): sustained baseline ~18 TPS, expected short bursts up to 220 TPS (10–15s windows) during morning syncs.
- Target unit economics / budget: team mentioned $900–$1,200 per 1M tokens as an acceptable range for initial contract.

Attachments: I attached the usage snapshot you shared (juno_usage_snapshot.csv) and our standard pricing band PDF for reference (redwood_pricing_options.pdf).

Next steps / asks from Juno:
1) Please confirm which monthly volume scenario you expect to budget against (72M vs 110M or a different number).
2) Can you confirm if the 220 TPS bursts are single-region or globally distributed?
3) Any constraints on retention or data residency we should consider for Private vs Hosted?

Our proposed short-term approach:
- Hosted API pilot with a 2-month consumption window, a capped burst allowance, and a target $/1M band we can lock for the pilot upon volume commit.
- If you confirm the 72M baseline, we can model committed discounts at 3 pricing tiers and return a simple PO-ready quote by EOD Friday.

Thanks — happy to hop on another 20m call if that helps.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

From: Priya Sharma <priya@junohealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Rogers <ben.rogers@junohealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-24T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing & capacity: monthly tokens + peak TPS (Juno Health) — recap

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick confirmations and a few clarifying points:

- Monthly volume: the 72M estimate is our current internal best-guess for Q3. If adoption accelerates we could approach the 100–110M range by Q4; planning should assume 72M baseline with headroom.
- Burst profile: primarily single-region (US-East) for now; we do expect a few geographically distributed calls from our remote workforce, but not major multi-region spikes.
- Budget: the $900–$1,200 / 1M tokens range is what our procurement and finance would be comfortable seeing for a pilot (we need to show conservative $/1M to the CFO).
- Data residency: Hosted is fine for pilot; we will need SOC2 evidence and confirmation that logs are retained for 30 days and can be exported on demand.

Ben and I are open to the 20m follow-up. Can you send a draft quote that includes: (a) pilot pricing for 72M/month, (b) committed discount bands for 72–110M, (c) burst allowance and overage rates, and (d) SOC2/Audit link?

Thanks —
Priya Sharma
Head of Product Integrations, Juno Health
priya@junohealth.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding Priya's confirmation. Key asks for pricing ops:
- Build a pilot quote for 72M/mo baseline, include committed tiers up to 110M. Aim to show a target band that yields ~$1,000 / 1M tokens in the baseline proposal but also a concessional tier (e.g., $900 / 1M) if they commit to 6 months.
- Burst handling: propose a burst pool (500k tokens/day free within pilot) then per-Million overage rate at list price + 20% uplift; include a 220 TPS short-burst operational note.
- Compliance: include SOC2 report link and a 30-day logs export procedure.

Priya asked for a PO-ready quote by EOD Friday — can we get a tight one-sheet? I attached redwood_pricing_options.pdf for reference.

Sergio

Sergio / team / Priya —

Tagged a few quick options below we can turn into a single-page quote:

Option A — Pilot (recommended)- Baseline: 72M tokens/month
- Price: $1,000 per 1M tokens
- Commitment: month-to-month pilot (2 months) with a 6% prepay discount if they prepay month 2
- Burst: 500k tokens/day pooled free; overage at $1,300 / 1M tokens
- Deliverables: SOC2 link, 30-day log export steps, 24/7 support during pilot

Option B — Committed 6-month
- Baseline band: 72–90M tokens/month
- Price: $950 per 1M tokens for committed months
- Higher band (90–110M): $900 per 1M tokens
- Burst: configurable daily pool; reduced overage ($1,150 / 1M)
- SLA: 99.9% availability for hosted endpoints

Operational notes: include a short operational runbook for 220 TPS bursts (auto-scaling guidance, recommended concurrency limits on client).

Priya — if either of these look reasonable I can convert to a PO-ready PDF and include HubSpot line items + a DocuSign link. If you want a lower baseline price we can swap tiers but will need a minimum 6-month commit.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
